title: Why You Can't Tickle Yourself
hook: You cannot tickle yourself, and your brain is the reason.
script: You cannot tickle yourself, and your brain is the reason. When you move your own hand, your cerebellum predicts the touch before it lands. Your brain does this all day, to save its attention for real surprises. So why does a friend's touch still make you laugh? Because your brain cannot predict what someone else will do. It is the same system that tells you the world is shaking, not just your head. Could you ever fool it into tickling you? Scientists have: add a small delay to your own touch, and it tickles again.
